# NASA imagery sources

Images are resized to WebP for page performance. Credit to NASA and the named mission teams on the source pages. NASA does not endorse N9 GROUP.

- **Carina Nebula, Cosmic Cliffs**: [NASA Webb source](https://science.nasa.gov/asset/webb/cosmic-cliffs-in-the-carina-nebula-nircam-image/) — credit NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI. Used for `nebula.webp`.

- **Sun**: [NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory](https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/image-of-sun-from-nasas-solar-dynamics-observatory/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/photojournal/pia/pia26/pia26681/PIA26681.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 900×900 resize.
- **Mercury**: [https://science.nasa.gov/mercury/](https://science.nasa.gov/mercury/) — [image](https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/mercury-messenger-globe-pia15162.jpg) — 900×900 source resize.
- **Venus**: [https://science.nasa.gov/venus/](https://science.nasa.gov/venus/) — [image](https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/688-venus-1200-jpg.webp) — 900×506 source resize.
- **Earth**: [https://science.nasa.gov/earth/](https://science.nasa.gov/earth/) — [image](https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/GSFC_20171208_Archive_e001016/GSFC_20171208_Archive_e001016~large.jpg) — 900×506 source resize.
- **Mars**: [https://science.nasa.gov/mars/](https://science.nasa.gov/mars/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/mars/resources/detail_files/7/7668_Mars-viking-2-orbiter-global-view-partial-valles-marinares-PIA04304-full2.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 900×853 source resize.
- **Jupiter**: [https://science.nasa.gov/jupiter/](https://science.nasa.gov/jupiter/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/solar/internal_resources/4204/Jupiter_against_black_background_of_space.jpeg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 900×900 source resize.
- **Saturn**: [https://science.nasa.gov/resource/saturn-planet-six/](https://science.nasa.gov/resource/saturn-planet-six/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/solar/2023/09/p/i/a/1/PIA12567-800w.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 800×472 source resize.
- **Uranus**: [https://science.nasa.gov/uranus/](https://science.nasa.gov/uranus/) — [image](https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/PIA18182/PIA18182~orig.jpg) — 900×900 source resize.
- **Neptune**: [https://science.nasa.gov/neptune/](https://science.nasa.gov/neptune/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/solar/2023/09/p/i/a/0/PIA01492-1.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 900×899 source resize.
- **Milky Way**: [https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/a-cauldron-of-stars-at-the-galaxys-center/](https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/a-cauldron-of-stars-at-the-galaxys-center/) — [image](https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/psd/photojournal/pia/pia03/pia03654/PIA03654.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) — 1280×923 source resize.
